harness: Variant A (part a): AgentDyn fork of AgentDojo v0.1.35 as released (a75aba7 / 5cea5891, 2025-10-27; https://github.com/ethz-spylab/agentdojo/releases/tag/v0.1.35), package name/version unchanged (`agentdojo` 0.1.35, so version_identifies_code=false); 13 files modified (openai_llm.py silently drops malformed tool calls; benchmark.py imposes utility False/security True on JSONDecodeError; model_output_from_messages takes the last assistant message anywhere; system prompt adds an auto-complete line). January runs predate the repository (created 2026-01-29), so the producing code is unpinned. Known bugs of that code relevant to the logs: (1) OpenAI-compatible client sends `temperature or NOT_GIVEN`, so 0.0 is dropped and the provider default applies (AgentDyn #2, fixed 2026-03-04 after all January runs; https://github.com/SaFo-Lab/AgentDyn/blob/de473e58/src/agentdojo/agent_pipeline/llms/openai_llm.py#L179); the Google client passes temperature=0.0 (google_llm.py l. 285 at de473e58); (2) LocalLLM (SecAlign) turns server errors into an empty final answer scored as a failed attack (agentdojo #220), drops calls with empty body or trailing text (#219) and fenced calls (#202), and sends an unlogged random seed per request; (3) --max-workers > 1 passes benchmark_suite arguments in the wrong order (#212 reports a crash, #177 corrupted results) [unknown whether used]; (4) tool results with non-ASCII are \uXXXX-escaped by yaml.safe_dump/json.dumps (#214); (5) security_from_traces counts proposed calls (#189; used by AgentDyn only after the 2026-05-02 fix, not for the logs); (6) tool_filter can yield zero tool calls (#209, reported for a local model only); (7) TraceLogger keeps only the last of up to 3 passes. Variant B (part b): Progent vendored with AgentDojo 0.1.29 (no evaluation_timestamp, no package version, unmodified 0.1.29 system prompt; its suites differ in user_tasks.py, github injection_tasks.py and task_suite.py). Variant C (part c): standalone SaFo-Lab/DRIFT pipeline_main.py (January 2026, before 1af2672c), outputs re-keyed conversations->messages and relocated by the AgentDyn authors (E11).
